brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Sunvale, the community energy cooperative in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: optimistic, local and trustworthy, not corporate-green; for neighbours who co-own solar roofs. No suns with rays, leaves, lightning bolts, houses or plugs. Web, a members' app icon (iOS, Android), social, and print for flyers.

claim.notes: All seven concepts across two rounds failed the critic's blind gate, so nothing was finalized, exported or installed.

concepts.title: Between Neighbours
readsAs: two figures (adult and child) with a ball between them
two leaning rounded slabs like gravestones
a broken lowercase n with a dot
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 a keyhole (privacy cliche) / shirt collar; s2 a person bust with an amber head, or two leaning buildings under a sun; s3 a keyhole; s4 a camera icon (UI); s5 a quotation mark at 16 px / bitten tombstones. s1, s3, s4, s5 struck. Pick s2: the asymmetry (tall + small leaning in) is the only version where 'two neighbours' beats 'keyhole'. Risks: single-person avatar reading, and amber sun on navy echoes Energy4All. Move: make the two figures clearly separate and unequal (wider gap, more lean, distinct tops) so it reads as two people, not one coat; place the sun so it is not a head on either; shift the ink off Energy4All navy toward a deep warm ink (aubergine/brown).

concepts.title: Commons
readsAs: a shop awning / market-stall store icon
a skirt or tutu
a little table or stool with a top bar
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as (32 px): s1 a stacked burger/pancake pile, risk of poop-emoji reading, repeats the struck burger; s2 a loading spinner or a sun with segmented rays (owner ban), table not legible; s4 a bitten cookie (cookie-consent icon), stock 0.83; s3 a split dome: mushroom cap / umbrella / parachute first, awning second. Struck s1, s2, s4. Pick s3: only one with no UI or banned reading, warm and civic, the amber centre panel carries 'my share in a shared whole'. Risk: the two drooping outer lobes make it a mushroom or jellyfish, and with no hem it is not yet an awning. Move: give it a market awning's scalloped valance, one continuous scalloped hem across all three panels, with a flatter, wider canopy so it reads as a stall canopy and not a cap; keep panels unequal with the amber centre widest; open real gaps between panels (overlap warning) so it holds in one colour.

concepts.title: Sun Terminal
readsAs: a heavy serif S with an orange ball at its top-right
an S app icon carrying an unread-notification badge
a bouncing ball / juggling S
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as (32 px): s1 S with an amber dot floating at its shoulder (i-dot/typo risk again); s2 a fat plum serif S whose top terminal IS an amber ball, a ball-terminal sun; s3 S with a sun and a dark half-dome below, reads as two stray marks / an S between punctuation; s4 a small lowercase s with an orange dot, weakest, generic; s5 S with a dot tucked in the bowl, reads as a smudge at 16 px. Pick s2: the only one where the sun is part of the letter rather than a dot beside it, which is what keeps it from the round-1 'dot over a letter reads as a typo' failure; strongest 16 px (0.95). Risk: initial + orange dot is a common monogram trope, so ownability depends entirely on the join. Move: make the arc visibly flow into the sun (no gap, no crescent knockout), sun noticeably larger than a normal ball terminal so it reads as a deliberate sun, and keep the high-contrast warm serif. Wordmark: draft B 'Sunvale' is legible and clearly not a rounded-lowercase coop wordmark; tighten 'Su' spacing and check the sun doesn't collide with the u at 32 px.

concepts.title: Sundial
readsAs: the numeral 4 in a circle
a sailboat sail and boom (yacht club badge)
a compass needle or clock hand
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as (32 px): s1 a pie chart with a wedge missing and a slanted amber '4'/'A' in it; s3 a clock or compass face with an amber blade and a white needle hand; s4 the same pie-chart wedge on a disc with a flat base. Nobody reads 'sundial' first: the outlined amber gnomon reads as a leaning letter (A/4) and the wedge cuts read as a chart. Strike s1 and s4 (pie-chart/finance-chart reading). Pick s3, the only one without a cut wedge: the needle shadow at least reads as time. Risks: clock/compass UI icon, gnomon-as-letter. Move: draw the gnomon as an unmistakable right-triangle fin standing on the shadow line (vertical edge, no rounded white outline), shadow as one long tapered band from its foot, so the pair reads 'object casting a shadow' before 'clock hand'. If it still reads as a clock at 32 px, drop it.

concepts.title: Share Token
readsAs: the generic user/profile avatar icon (head over shoulders)
a person sitting in a bathtub or hot tub
a webcam / camera bump
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as (32 px): s1 a bowler/hard hat (struck); s2 an amber ball in a scooped tile, also a head-over-shoulders profile/avatar silhouette; s3 a moustached face (struck); s4 a letter U / horseshoe magnet holding a ball; s5 a Pokeball (struck). Pick s2: the only survivor where the sun sits in a vale rather than spelling a letter (s4 = 'U', wrong letter). Biggest risk: the generic user/avatar icon reading, which would cap distinctiveness and make it look like a default profile picture on a members' app. Move: make the bowl a shallow wide valley (wider than the sun, gentle slopes reaching the tile edges) and drop the sun so it is half-sunk below the rim line, killing the head-and-shoulders silhouette; keep the white gap ring. Candidly the weakest of the three; a tile + ball is close to stock geometry.

concepts.title: Vale Line
readsAs: a snail or curled worm
a tadpole/sperm-like squiggle with a dot
an eye or ear swirl
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 a tadpole / sperm / backwards 6; s2 a curl or snail-like swirl ending in an amber dot; s3 a waving stick creature with one eye, or a fried egg on a wave; s4 a magnifying glass / Q (search icon); s5 a tadpole/sperm (unfortunate). s1, s4, s5 struck; s3 weakest at 16 px (79%). Pick s2: only one where sun and valley are two things, warm rose + amber is on brief and nothing like the category. Risks: snail/curl reading, sperm-like tail, dot merging with line. Move: open a clear gap between line and amber disc, make the left stroke read as a landscape dip (flatter, longer, maybe slight swell) so it is a horizon, not a tail; keep it one confident stroke, no hand-drawn wobble.

concepts.title: Joined Hands Wordmark
readsAs: the letters 'un'
a serif 'm' variant or 'UN' monogram
the negation prefix un- (undo, un-plugged)
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 the letters 'un' in a stock serif (nothing changed visibly); s2 a continuous ribbon wave, 'un' or a sideways S; s3 'va' in a stock serif; s4 a horseshoe magnet / U with a sun in a bowl (sunrise cliche); s5 a sunrise inside an e (cliche). s4, s5 struck; s1, s3 not ownable. Pick s2: the only icon with a gesture of its own, holds at 16 px (97%), and the S-like wave hints Sunvale. Risk: it drifts toward the banned generic rounded lowercase look and a sine-wave/UI reading. Move: give the ribbon a deliberate stroke contrast or terminal shape that ties it to a legible, characterful serif wordmark, and make the join in the word visible so the icon is clearly cut from it.
